newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania guarantees SAAB plane lease.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania guarantees SAAB plane lease.

text.p: The Lithuanian government on Wednesday said it was issuing a $200,000 state guarantee to SAAB for Lithuanian Airlines to lease one SAAB 340B turboprop plane.
The guarantee was issued to Saab Aircraft Credit AB, the government said in a statement.
State-owned Lithuanian Airlines has signed a five-year lease agreement with SAAB at a price of $60,000 per year for the first two years and $67,000 per year for the next three years.
The plane is planned to be used on routes to Berlin, St.Petersburg, Kiev, Kaliningrad, Tallinn, Riga and Warsaw.
The transport ministry said it expects the aircraft to make some $215,000 annual profit for Lithuanian Airlines.
Lithuanian Airlines currently uses three Boeing 737-200 aircrafts, two of them bought in 1995 and the third leased from Irish GPA leasing company.
